title: Derivative of odd majority on the middle layer
statement: For every natural number $m$, the discrete derivative in the last coordinate of majority on the $(2m+1)$-dimensional sign cube, viewed as a real-valued function, is the indicator of the middle layer on the first $2m$ coordinates: it equals $1$ exactly when those coordinates contain $m$ positive signs, and equals $0$ otherwise.
